user.title: Connect to UniFi Access
user.description: Create the API token inside UniFi Access (Settings → System → API Token, at https://your-console/access/settings/system), not in UniFi OS's own settings, and give it every permission it offers. Keep it somewhere safe.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the console running UniFi Access. The API port (12445) is added unless you give another.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for the console's default self-signed certificate.

calendar.title: Guest calendar
calendar.description: Every event on this calendar gives a guest UniFi Access for the event's times. The guest's name is the event title, or a "NAME: Jane Doe" line in the description; a "PIN: 1234" line gives them a PIN. Events with the same PIN, and the occurrences of a repeating event, share one visitor.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: UniFi Access at {host} rejected the API token. Enter a new one.

error.unifi_os_key: That is a UniFi OS API key (it works for UniFi Network or Protect). Create the token inside UniFi Access instead: Access → Settings → System → API Token.

abort.already_configured: This calendar is already synced to this controller.
